# `page` records

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from schemas/0.1/page.schema.json. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

One drawn sheet (doc 03 §6, rank 30). It stores no revision, Prev/Next or title-block text (D-05, D-06);
`title` is the page description and `description_override` the rare override of the project
description.

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | `page` |
| File | `pages/<page>.jsonl` |
| Rank | 30 |
| Status | implemented |
| Record version | 1 |
| Schema | [`page.schema.json`](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/schemas/0.1/page.schema.json) |

## Types

### Folio

The folio of a page (doc 03 §6).

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | [`Ident`](#ident) or `null` | no |  | A label such as "101a" or "101.1". |
| `number` | integer (format `uint32`, min 0) | yes |  | The folio number. |
| `section` | [`Uuid`](#uuid) or `null` | no |  | The section, if any. |

### Grid

A rational grid step num/den in nanometres (doc 05 §3.2). JSON Schema cannot express that num/den is reduced or at least 1 nm (num >= den): the reader rejects unreduced and sub-nanometre steps.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `den` | integer (min 1, max 9007199254740991) | yes |  |  |
| `num` | integer (min 1, max 9007199254740991) | yes |  |  |

### Ident

An identifier: non-empty, one line (no control character U+0000 to U+001F or U+007F to U+009F), without leading or trailing white space (the Unicode White_Space set); interior spaces are allowed (doc 05 §3.2). JSON Schema cannot express Unicode Normalization Form C; the reader rejects non-NFC text.

Type: string (at least 1 character(s))

Pattern: `^[^\u0000-\u0020\u007F-\u00A0\u1680\u2000-\u200A\u2028\u2029\u202F\u205F\u3000](?:[^\u0000-\u001F\u007F-\u009F]*[^\u0000-\u0020\u007F-\u00A0\u1680\u2000-\u200A\u2028\u2029\u202F\u205F\u3000])?$`

### MlText

Multilingual text: a neutral string, or an object keyed by canonical BCP 47 tags with non-empty string values (doc 05 §3.2). JSON Schema cannot express that all text is NFC or that the keys are in ascending byte order; the reader rejects both.

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**

   Shape: string

2. **Form 2**

   Shape: map of string (at least 1 character(s)) (at least 1 propert(ies))

### PageType

Page type (FR-PAG-001). `report` pages are always generated, never stored.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"title_page"` | Title page (cover form). |
| `"table_of_contents"` | Table of contents. |
| `"section_divider"` | Section divider. |
| `"graphic"` | Graphic page without electrical meaning. |
| `"single_line"` | Single-line diagram. |
| `"multi_line"` | Multi-line schematic. |
| `"overview"` | Overview. |
| `"bus_topology"` | Bus topology. |
| `"fluid"` | Fluid-power schematic. |
| `"assembly_overview"` | Assembly overview. |
| `"panel_layout"` | Panel layout. |
| `"model_view"` | 3D model view. |
| `"external_document"` | External document. |
| `"report"` | Report (generated only). |

### Scale

The scale of a page (doc 03 §6): `"not_to_scale"` (the default, omitted) or `{"one_to": n}` for 1:n.

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**: Not to scale (schematics).

   Shape: `"not_to_scale"`

2. **Form 2**: 1:n (layout pages: "1:10" on 902).

   Shape: object { `one_to`: integer (format `uint32`, min 0) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `one_to` | integer (format `uint32`, min 0) | yes |  |  |

### SourceRef

The import provenance of a record (doc 14 §2.3, ADR-0004 amendment 1): the lineage and the source key
from which the record's ID `v5(lineage namespace, key)` was derived.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | string | yes |  | The source key, byte for byte (NFC), such as `qet:el:<uuid>`. |
| `lineage` | [`Uuid`](#uuid) | yes |  | The import lineage. |

### StructureAssignment

Which structure node a page, device or structure box belongs to, one slot per aspect (doc 03 §5).
Members follow the canonical aspect order of `ew_rds::Aspect`; the product aspect is the device tree and
has no slot.

```
use ew_schema::StructureAssignment;

let s: StructureAssignment = serde_json::from_str(
    r#"{"function":"7d2c95e0-1f4a-5b38-a6e7-0c93b5d1f284","location":"none"}"#,
).unwrap();
assert!(s.installation_site.is_none()); // absent: inherit
```

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `document_kind` | [`Slot`](#slot) or `null` | no |  | `&` (pages only). |
| `function` | [`Slot`](#slot) or `null` | no |  | `=` |
| `functional_assignment` | [`Slot`](#slot) or `null` | no |  | `==` |
| `installation_site` | [`Slot`](#slot) or `null` | no |  | `++` |
| `location` | [`Slot`](#slot) or `null` | no |  | `+` |
| `type` | [`Slot`](#slot) or `null` | no |  | `%` |
| `user_defined` | [`Slot`](#slot) or `null` | no |  | `#` |

### Slot

A structure slot: a structure node ID or "none"; absent means inherit (doc 05 §3.2).

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**

   Shape: [`Uuid`](#uuid)

2. **Form 2**

   Shape: `"none"`

### Uuid

A lower-case hyphenated UUID (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (at least 36 character(s), at most 36 character(s))

Pattern: `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`
